criteria.title: Agent-first init reaches Main and Admin without a development command
criteria.nextGate: Build a clean, signed or notarized platform bundle, invoke the init skill on clean macOS, Windows, and Linux hosts, install and start Main plus the co-located Worker through the packaged native lifecycle, and record Main/Admin readiness plus disabled and enabled Admin auto-open behavior across login and explicit service reconfiguration.

criteria.title: Only the current Device appears initially
criteria.nextGate: Run the packaged Main and real Admin API from a clean home, record that only the current Device appears before enrollment, and prove that the list expands only after a successful grant enrollment.

criteria.title: Embedded SQLite and external PostgreSQL both work
criteria.nextGate: Capture immutable final-commit SQLite and PostgreSQL contract results for every composed repository, including configuration, Artifact metadata, Device observations, owner authentication, action authorization, Discord state, and Device channels. Then run the packaged backup, verify, and fresh-target restore CLI on clean hosts and prove migration integrity, exact Worker-action once-consumption, channel replay, and post-restore reconciliation for both deployment choices.

criteria.title: An approved Discord Community Server and Forum bind successfully
criteria.nextGate: Bind the composed production Discord runtime to a real approved Community Forum using the final managed credential path, then record permission, intent, Gateway Resume, HTTP reconciliation, rate-limit, mobile-control, and Components v2 proof across Main restart.

criteria.title: macOS, Windows, and Linux Devices enroll with single-use grants
criteria.nextGate: Build and sign the final platform bundles, invoke the packaged join skill, and use the composed enrollment HTTPS and mutual-TLS WSS runtime to enroll real macOS, Windows, and Linux Devices; include signed macOS helper and clean-host lifecycle proof.

criteria.title: Every OS service survives process and expected host restart
criteria.nextGate: Build, sign, and where applicable notarize final platform bundles containing the target-native core and session-helper hosts, then use the packaged lifecycle to capture privileged clean install, exact-identity health, process restart, reboot, login/logout, upgrade, failed-health rollback, and uninstall proof on all three OS families.

criteria.title: Device specification, routes, health, locks, and Runs are accurate
criteria.nextGate: Run the packaged Main and enrolled macOS, Windows, and Linux Workers, then compare the durable observation and Admin projections with each host's real Facts, Capabilities, Roles, Instructions, Policies, route health, named Resource Locks, load, outbox depth, and current Runs across reconnect and restart.

criteria.title: Per-Device connection methods are deterministic and prompt-free
criteria.nextGate: Using the composed Main Device channel and Worker transport resolver, run enrolled Devices over distinct real Tailscale, Omada, and direct WSS profiles; force preferred-route failure and record deterministic fallback, redacted attempt traces, and proof that route mechanics never enter Main Agent prompts.

criteria.title: One Forum post creates one Task and replies resume it
criteria.nextGate: Run the composed production Discord, SQL, and Main Task path with a real approved Community Forum; prove starter and thread event reordering, one post to one durable Task, replies to the same Task, Gateway reconnect, archived-thread HTTP reconciliation, and Main restart without duplication.

criteria.title: Different Forum posts remain context-isolated Tasks
criteria.nextGate: Prove distinct live Forum posts create distinct durable Tasks, Coordinator Sessions, summaries, and provider-native session bindings with no cross-Task prompt input.

criteria.title: Clear work auto-starts and ambiguity asks one useful question
criteria.nextGate: Run the composed pinned Coordinator adapter and Discord projection against a real provider and Forum; record one clear Auto Task entering execution without plan approval and one materially ambiguous Task persisting and presenting exactly one targeted owner question.

criteria.title: Main parallelizes work across two Devices and synthesizes reports
criteria.nextGate: Run the composed authoritative Main, Device channel, and Worker path with pinned live adapters on two enrolled real Devices, force parallel Work Orders, and record both authoritative reports plus the Coordinator's completion-criteria synthesis.

criteria.title: General Runs are concurrent while desktop input is exclusive
criteria.nextGate: Compose durable Resource Locks, external monotonic desktop authority, and authenticated native helpers, then prove real desktop-session serialization while unrelated Agent Runs remain concurrent.

criteria.title: Codex and Claude adapters start, observe, and resume native sessions
criteria.nextGate: Run authenticated, pinned Codex App Server and Claude Agent SDK start, stream, exact-session steering, resume, cancel, checkpoint continuation, and process-restart smokes through the packaged Main and Worker path on every target OS where each provider is advertised.

criteria.title: Coordinator pinning and Worker provider participation are correct
criteria.nextGate: Commit and attest the provider-binding, safe-lineage, Worker-restart, and Main-restart implementation tests; then prove a pinned live Coordinator remains unchanged while the other provider completes a provider-bound Worker workstream.

criteria.title: Native-session loss continues from a durable checkpoint
criteria.nextGate: Delete or make unavailable live Codex and Claude Coordinator and Worker sessions across packaged Main and Worker restart, then prove each new native session continues only from the bounded, hash-verified Task checkpoint, records an explicit parent lineage, and receives no Secret, Device Knowledge, private path, or unrelated Task content.

criteria.title: Local Markdown Knowledge is useful and never uploaded to Main
criteria.nextGate: Build the packaged Worker and inspect live SQL, protocol traffic, first-turn and resumed provider prompts, Admin, and diagnostics to prove no local metadata or content reaches Main and no automatic reinjection occurs.

criteria.title: Qualifying Knowledge updates rebuild the local index deterministically
criteria.nextGate: Use the composed one-time Knowledge MCP in a packaged Worker Run to create and update a qualifying Markdown note, record deterministic immediate index visibility and restart rebuild, and inspect protocol, SQL, and diagnostics to prove no filename, title, link, preview, index, or content reaches Main.

criteria.title: Computer Use completes and cancels on macOS, Windows, and graphical Linux
criteria.nextGate: Keep all three OS ADRs proposed until final-commit native builds and clean-host proof exist. Compose each native candidate behind the authenticated session-helper and exact lease/fence/Policy authority, package and sign it, then pass fixture, screenshot, permission denial/revocation, lock/logout, cancellation, emergency-stop, helper replacement, and capacity-one desktop-lock tests on real Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME Wayland hosts. Windows additionally requires publisher-signed immutable bundles, owner-picker consent and withdrawal, service/helper login and reboot recovery, locked and switched sessions, UAC secure desktop and UIPI denial, partial SendInput, display/DPI change, and helper-crash evidence. macOS additionally requires a stable signed/notarized identity, owner-granted TCC, active Aqua and Secure Event Input cases, and real ScreenCaptureKit, AXUIElement, and CGEvent evidence.

criteria.title: Headless Linux remains useful and reports Computer Use unavailable
criteria.nextGate: Install the real Worker service on the headless NAS, record Computer Use as unavailable, and complete a non-desktop Work Order while the core remains healthy without a session helper.

criteria.title: Worker report becomes a concise Discord result and Artifact link
criteria.nextGate: Using the packaged composed runtime, upload a report from a real enrolled Worker, persist its authoritative metadata in SQLite and PostgreSQL, and prove that the same result appears in a live Discord Forum as a concise native presentation plus an openable isolated Artifact link.

criteria.title: Private, authenticated, signed-link, and public Artifact modes work
criteria.nextGate: Run the packaged Gateway through real owner routes and credentials, then prove private-network, authenticated, revocable and expiring signed-link, and intentionally public access from the required mixed-network viewers with durable exposure audit.

criteria.title: Default static HTML cannot run scripts or access Admin authority
criteria.nextGate: Deploy Admin, static Artifact, and interactive Artifact listeners on genuinely distinct origins and run browser hostile-HTML and SVG fixtures against real Admin and Artifact credentials.

criteria.title: Official packages auto-install while new sources and installers prompt
criteria.nextGate: On clean supported hosts, run one install-only request through each advertised configured manager and current Configuration Policy, then prove an executable replacement fails closed and repository additions, remote installers, widened argv, and denied approvals execute no subprocess. Record the exact manager source state and required narrow service privilege as live evidence.

criteria.title: Network and firewall changes require approval and honor denial
criteria.nextGate: On packaged disposable Workers for each OS, request an exact network or firewall mutation through the composed platform-mutation capability, present the pending Approval in Discord and Admin, deny it, and prove zero subprocess execution plus durable denial and audit across reconnect and restart; then prove an approved exact grant cannot authorize a widened target or argv.

criteria.title: Device Secret values never leak through any product surface
criteria.nextGate: Compose the implemented Device-local stores and scoped credential injection, build/sign/notarize and prove the macOS helper, prove graphical and headless Linux lifecycle, then run adversarial leak scans through the integrated database, provider prompts and output, logs, diagnostics, Discord, Admin, and Artifacts on every OS.

criteria.title: Route failure falls back deterministically before Agent diagnosis
criteria.nextGate: Run authenticated Worker traffic across real mixed routes, force the preferred path to fail, and record deterministic fallback, bounded exhaustion, redacted evidence, and only then Agent escalation.

criteria.title: Disconnected Workers buffer and resynchronize without duplicate work
criteria.nextGate: Source tests cover durable rejection and acknowledgement of well-formed terminal events for expired or replaced Runs while malformed or unknown identifiers fail closed. The remaining gate is to force real network and process interruption through the packaged composed channel, then prove strict-prefix Worker outbox delivery, replay after both endpoints restart, continued draining of later valid events, and exactly-once external effects.

criteria.title: Main restart reconciles Discord, Runs, leases, and singleton authority
criteria.nextGate: Capture immutable-commit live evidence on Windows, macOS, and Linux plus PostgreSQL: force process and host restarts, crash the active Main, start a second contender, and prove singleton exclusion plus Discord, Run, lease, and outbox reconciliation before dispatch.

criteria.title: Admin can inspect and control Tasks during Discord outage
criteria.nextGate: Run the complete six-locale browser suite against the packaged Main rather than mocked HTTP, disable Discord, and prove authenticated inspection, emergency Task creation, pause, resume, cancel, retry, locale persistence, untranslated owner content, accessibility, responsive overflow safety, and restart persistence.

criteria.title: Audit explains every security- and scheduling-relevant action
criteria.nextGate: Complete and query one production audit projection that also binds Worker action authorization/consumption, platform-mutation receipts, Admin Task controls, resource-lock and lease decisions, and system incidents to their exact Task, Run, Device, principal, and outcome across SQLite and PostgreSQL restart.

criteria.title: Automated, six-locale Admin, and live smoke matrices pass on declared OS versions
criteria.nextGate: Run final-commit hosted CI, the complete six-locale Admin unit/browser matrix, and target-native bundle smokes, then complete and attach the owner-controlled macOS, Windows, Linux, Discord, provider, mixed-route, service, and Computer Use lab matrix.

criteria.title: Workspace Tasks preserve isolation and resume in the correct directory
criteria.nextGate: Build the packaged Worker, register real Workspaces, and prove live native-session resume and cleanup reject a changed Device, Workspace, cwd, worktree, or unapproved dirty state on every supported OS.

criteria.title: Concurrent native-session appends serialize or reject cleanly
criteria.nextGate: Run concurrent appends against live Codex and Claude native sessions through Worker restart using the composed shared file-backed session lease, and verify one writer with no transcript interleaving plus acquire, renew, release, and crash-expiry behavior.

criteria.title: A runaway Agent stops at its finite hard budget
criteria.nextGate: Run a deliberately runaway adapter through the composed packaged Main and Worker journey with very small Task and Work Order limits; prove the durable hard Budget cancels the active Run and process tree, blocks retries and excess child Work Orders across restart, records the limit event, and resumes only after an owner-authorized extension.

criteria.title: Remote owner claim is impossible and recovery survives Discord outage
criteria.nextGate: Run the packaged separate claim and Admin listeners on every Main OS, capture a non-loopback claim rejection and HTTPS session controls, then prove recovery, session revocation, and Task control while Discord is unavailable across restart.
